course.name: course
course.role: legacy regression; previously used for development

queries.information_need: User wants a tool to recover/crack Wi-Fi (WEP/WPA) passwords.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page is about a tool that cracks or captures Wi-Fi keys/handshakes.

queries.information_need: User wants a tool to find/exploit SQL injection.
queries.relevance_rule: A user-operable tool explicitly documenting SQLi detection or exploitation is relevant, including an explicitly SQLi-capable SIP fuzzer; API-only library or post-exploitation files alone are insufficient.

queries.information_need: User wants to learn how to scan ports / a port scanner.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page explains port scanning or documents a port scanner.

queries.information_need: User wants to intercept / inspect encrypted HTTPS traffic (man-in-the-middle proxy).
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page documents a tool or method that intercepts or decrypts HTTPS/TLS traffic (e.g. mitmproxy, burpsuite, Wireshark TLS decryption).

queries.information_need: User wants a scanner for web app vulnerabilities.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page documents a web vulnerability scanner.

queries.information_need: User wants to capture/analyze network traffic.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page is about packet capture/sniffing.

queries.information_need: User wants to use/run a Metasploit exploit module.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page explains Metasploit modules/exploitation.

queries.information_need: User wants to unpack / decompile an Android app (APK) to read its code.
queries.relevance_rule: APK unpacking/decompilation/reconstruction leading to readable code; runtime hooks alone do not satisfy decompile.

queries.information_need: User wants to enumerate directories/files on a web server.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page is about web content/directory discovery.

queries.information_need: User wants to get a reverse shell on a target.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant if the page explains how to create or catch a reverse shell (e.g. msfvenom payloads, GTFOBins reverse-shell entries, netcat).

queries.information_need: Configure a trusted certificate for a TLS inspection proxy.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains proxy CA installation or client TLS trust configuration.

queries.information_need: Inspect a running Android app with instrumentation.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents Frida Android instrumentation, attachment or hooks.

queries.information_need: Understand TCP SYN port scanning.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains SYN scan behavior or its Nmap usage.

queries.information_need: Find DNS reconnaissance tools.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents DNS records, subdomain discovery or DNS enumeration tools.

queries.information_need: Recover passwords from offline hashes.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents a hash cracking tool or relevant workflow, not remote login guessing.

queries.information_need: Pause and inspect an HTTP request in a proxy.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains an interception proxy or request interception workflow.

queries.information_need: Decode Android application resources.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains APK resource extraction/decoding, not only runtime hooks.

queries.information_need: Filter already captured network traffic.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains Wireshark display filters or equivalent analysis.

queries.information_need: Identify a service from network responses.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains service/version detection or banner inspection.

queries.information_need: Locate unlinked content on a web server.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents web directory/file/content discovery.

queries.information_need: Manage an existing Metasploit session.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains listing, interacting with or managing sessions.

queries.information_need: Understand documented security behavior of binaries under sudo.
queries.relevance_rule: A GTFOBins entry or explanation with a sudo-specific function.

holdout.name: holdout
holdout.role: new frozen candidate test; group validation and human judgments pending

queries.information_need: Save captured traffic as a pcap file.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains packet capture with file output or saving captured packets.

queries.query: decrypt tls sessions with key log
queries.information_need: Analyze encrypted TLS traffic using session keys.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains TLS key logging/decryption in a packet analysis workflow.

queries.information_need: Show captured packets for a chosen IP address.
queries.relevance_rule: Provides relevant packet filtering guidance.

queries.information_need: Modify an intercepted HTTP response.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains response editing or a response hook in mitmproxy.

queries.information_need: Trust an interception proxy CA on Android.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains Android certificate installation/trust for proxy inspection.

queries.information_need: Send captured HTTP requests again.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains request/client replay in an HTTP analysis tool.

queries.information_need: Instrument an already running process with Frida.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains attaching, process selection or attach workflows.

queries.information_need: Observe or modify Java method behavior in a running Android app.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains Android Java method instrumentation/hooks.

queries.information_need: Inspect native modules loaded into a process.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains enumeration or inspection of native modules/libraries.

queries.information_need: Read reconstructed code from Android DEX files.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents decompilation or conversion leading to readable code; runtime hooking alone is insufficient.

queries.information_need: Inspect resources packaged in an Android APK.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents resource extraction, decoding or inspection.

queries.information_need: Convert DEX content to Java class/JAR form.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents a DEX-to-JAR converter or workflow.

queries.information_need: Determine versions of services on open ports.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains Nmap service/version detection.

queries.information_need: Determine a hosts operating system with Nmap.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains OS fingerprinting/detection.

queries.information_need: Understand scanning UDP ports.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains UDP scan behavior, usage or interpretation.

queries.query: nmap host discovery without port scan
queries.information_need: Find active hosts without performing a port scan.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains host-discovery-only workflows; a general port-scan listing is insufficient.

queries.information_need: Discover web paths not linked from the homepage.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents web content/path enumeration tools or techniques.

queries.information_need: Discover nested directories on a web server.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains recursive web directory/content discovery.

queries.information_need: Find a tool for automated SQL injection detection.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents an automated SQLi detection/exploitation tool, not a generic library mention.

queries.information_need: Find tools for capturing or analyzing WPA authentication handshakes.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents Wi-Fi/WPA handshake capture or processing.

queries.information_need: Determine what kind of password hash a value uses.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents hash identification, not only password cracking.

queries.information_need: Create a payload using Metasploit tooling.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains payload generation rather than an unrelated API definition.

queries.information_need: Learn how to select/configure/run a Metasploit exploit module.
queries.relevance_rule: Explains an end-user module workflow; module development alone is insufficient.

queries.information_need: Locate documented sudo behavior for Unix binaries.
queries.relevance_rule: A GTFOBins entry with a sudo function or overview of that feature.
